title: Discourse Heuristics For Paradoxically Moral Self-Correction
findings: The paper found that its proposed method for improving moral self-correction generalizes to unseen religious stereotypes for larger models (3B, 7B, 8B), showing improved performance. However, for the smallest model tested (1B), the performance on mitigating religious stereotypes decreased after fine-tuning, indicating a failure of generalization.
